why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session), confirm the domain against the project's own profile before touching it (forensics flags it)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the application page Go to the Fungo Labs application page to start your whitelist application.
2 Step 2 : Connect your X account Use your real X account. Only one application is accepted per account, and applying asks for no wallet and no signature.
3 Step 3 : Complete the four tasks The application lists four short actions on X to complete. The team reviews them by hand, in rounds.
4 Step 4 : Answer the three questions and seal Answer the three questions and submit. Once you submit, the application and its answers are locked.
5 Step 5 : Check your status Open the application checker to see your status, which reads "In review" until the team publishes decisions. Decisions are also announced on X .
6 Step 6 : Link your wallet and mint if approved If approved, you will be asked to link your minting wallet shortly before the mint. The page will be announced on X.
